title: The Quiet Weather
author: Lena Coldharbour
blurb: Ada Lockridge, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
